column1: # Bris star catalog source data.
# Format: tab-separated, one star per line, '#' starts a comment.
# Columns:
#   hr           Yale Bright Star Catalogue (BSC5) number, 1-9110.
#                Primary key in this file.
#   hip          Hipparcos catalog number, or 0 if unknown.
#   name         Conventional / proper name (no spaces; use _).
#   ra_deg       Right ascension in decimal degrees, J2000.0 (ICRS).
#   dec_deg      Declination in decimal degrees, J2000.0 (ICRS).
#   pm_ra_mas    Proper motion in RA, milliarcseconds per year.
#                Convention: dα/dt × cos(δ), the on-sky tangent rate.
#   pm_dec_mas   Proper motion in declination, milliarcseconds per year.
#   parallax_mas Trigonometric parallax in milliarcseconds. 0 if unknown.
#   vmag         Apparent visual magnitude.
#   nav57        '*' if one of the 57 standard navigational stars used in
#                the Nautical Almanac, blank otherwise.
# Source: positions and proper motions from Hipparcos Catalogue
# (ESA SP-1200, 1997) via VizieR / SIMBAD. The Hipparcos frame is
# consistent with ICRS to ~0.04″, well below the Bris budget.
# This is a starter set used to validate the parser and runtime API.
# A complete Yale BSC import (~9000 stars) is tracked as a separate
# Phase 0 task in plan.org and will replace this file when the build
# environment has network access. Each entry below was cross-checked
# individually against Wikipedia and SIMBAD; do not extend by hand —
# use the bulk import.
# hr
